_comment: Topic-specific categories. Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order).

categories.name: Not delivered or marked delivered
categories.description: Orders never arrive or show delivered but missing.

categories.name: Fake & counterfeit products
categories.description: Counterfeit or duplicate products from sellers.

categories.name: Wrong, damaged or used items
categories.description: Wrong item/size, damaged goods, used items, empty boxes.

categories.name: Returns refused or difficult
categories.description: Return rejected, pickup not arranged, non-returnable items.

categories.name: Refunds slow or missing
categories.description: Refunds pending for weeks or never credited.

categories.name: Late delivery & tracking
categories.description: Delivery dates slip, tracking stuck, no updates.
keywords: \blate\b|delay|tracking|where is my (order|parcel|package)|out for delivery|stuck in transit|expected delivery

categories.name: Orders cancelled by seller
categories.description: Orders auto-cancelled or cancelled after a price change.

categories.name: Seller & marketplace scams
categories.description: Fake sellers, fake reviews, third-party seller fraud.
keywords: scam|fraud|fake seller|third party seller|seller (not responding|scam)|fake reviews

categories.name: Payment & cash-on-delivery problems
categories.description: Payment debited but order failed, COD refused, double charges.

categories.name: Customer support
categories.description: Bots, unhelpful agents, no escalation path.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.

personas.name: Gift buyer
personas.description: Buying for someone else; deadlines matter.
